The '''''Punishing One''''' was a modified [[JumpMaster 5000/Legends|JumpMaster 5000]] and the personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], which he acquired in [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]].

==History==
[[File:Punishing_one.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Punishing One''{{'s}} stern]]
Like many starships employed by [[Fringer/Legends|fringe]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], it began as a stock transport. The [[JumpMaster 5000]], a crescent shaped transport, was the base of the ship, chosen for its ease of maintenance and simple customization.

Dengar modified the ''Punishing One'' to use a cutting-edge engine bay and armed the ship with a mini-[[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] and [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launcher. He also modified a quad-[[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] to operate using an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] built into the ship as a gunner, leaving him free to concentrate on flying. The increased [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] speed and weapons system gave ''Punishing One'' the punch it needed to handle any threats in [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] rather than relying on its slow Class 3 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].

The ship was flown primarily by Dengar, though in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], his girlfriend and future wife, [[Manaroo/Legends|Manaroo]], piloted it. Dengar utilized the ship during the daring rescue of [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], after the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] fell into the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].

Dengar also equipped his ship with a series of sensor beacons, which enabled him to monitor several different locations within a [[Star system/Legends|system]] at the same time. ''Punishing One'' contained no holding cells or cages, due to Dengar's tendency to take only [[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]], or to work with other bounty hunters, such as Boba Fett.
